concept: Moonlit puppet stage in a flooded jungle
creativeDirection: A handcrafted theatrical shadow-box diorama combining painted scenery, cut-paper figures, suspended ornaments, and miniature props photographed as a surreal stage set.
scene: A frontal view into a deep proscenium shadow-box stage where a flooded jungle clearing opens toward a glowing moon-disc backdrop, with shallow water across the floor and layered scenery receding into darkness.

elements.element: A single seated man in a vivid red armchair placed slightly left of center as the dominant grounded figure, with a pale plank-wall fragment and hanging hat turned into part of the stage set behind him.
A huge glowing white disc as the rear backdrop moon, with a tiny black island silhouette in the water near it and a flock of birds arcing up toward the upper right.
Two small figures standing together on a rust-colored leaf-strewn path at the edge of the jungle midground beneath heavy stormlike cloud flats.
Large foreshortened cut-paper hands reaching in from the right foreground, threaded among hanging white star ornaments.
The main environment: dense tropical foliage, river water, a white wading bird, distant elephants, and a crocodile near the front waterline.
A narrow glowing horizontal stage aperture high in the set containing a blurred woman under spotlights, like a secondary performance box.
A pole of red loudspeaker horns rising from the left background, silhouetted against twilight as part of the theatrical machinery.
A whimsical green-clad headless figure near pink open window frames on an upper side platform, framing a small crescent moon and stars.

coverSummaries.album: Let Me Come Over 25th Anniversary Edition
coverSummaries.description: A warm-toned photograph of a man sitting heavily in a bright red armchair in a sparse interior. He wears a hat, jacket, shirt, dark trousers, and shoes, and faces forward with a serious expression. Behind him is a pale wooden plank wall with a small framed picture on the upper left and another hat hanging on the upper right. A patterned circular rug is partly visible at the bottom right on a beige floor.
coverSummaries.signatureMotif: man seated in a red armchair

coverSummaries.description: A minimalist blue-toned cover showing a silhouetted person seated on a tiny rocky island or mound near the bottom center. A large glowing white circular disc dominates the background like a moon or sun, and a flock of black birds arcs upward across it toward the upper right. The composition is spacious with a soft gradient from deep blue to lighter blue.
coverSummaries.signatureMotif: silhouetted figure on a small island before a large glowing disc

coverSummaries.description: A staged photograph of two young figures standing side by side in the center of an autumnal landscape. One has long light hair and wears a short dark outfit with sneakers; the other has dark hair and wears a long dark garment. They stand on a leaf-strewn path surrounded by reddish shrubs and trees, with hills in the distance and dramatic heavy clouds filling the sky. A small building edge appears on the left.
coverSummaries.signatureMotif: two figures standing in an autumn landscape under dramatic clouds

coverSummaries.description: A high-contrast photograph of a person reaching both hands toward the camera, creating a foreshortened effect with the fingers spread wide in the foreground. Bright white star shapes hang on strings around the figure and overlap the hands and face. The background is dark with blue and purple lighting, and the person’s face is partly obscured by the hands and stars.
coverSummaries.signatureMotif: outstretched hands surrounded by hanging stars

coverSummaries.description: A framed painted jungle scene set within a dark border. Dense tropical foliage fills the right side, while a river or lagoon runs through the center-left. Visible animals include a white wading bird in the water, elephants in the distance, and a crocodile or alligator near the foreground waterline. The sky is dusky with a pale moon or sun low on the horizon, and the vegetation is lush and layered.
coverSummaries.signatureMotif: lush tropical jungle with river and animals

coverSummaries.description: A mostly deep blue cover with a narrow horizontal rectangular image across the middle. Inside the strip, a woman in a shiny dress appears seated or standing under bright stage-like spotlights in a dark space. The image is grainy and blurred, with strong light blooms above and around her, while the surrounding border remains solid blue.
coverSummaries.signatureMotif: woman under stage spotlights in a narrow central frame

coverSummaries.description: A beige textured background with a wide horizontal photograph centered in the lower half. The photo shows several red loudspeaker horns mounted on a white pole against a twilight sky with blue, purple, and pink tones above a dark horizon line. The layout is clean and graphic, with the speakers as the focal point.
coverSummaries.signatureMotif: cluster of red loudspeakers on a pole

coverSummaries.description: A simple hand-drawn illustration on a white background. In the center, a headless figure in loose green clothing stands facing an open pair of pink window frames that reveal a blue night sky with a small yellow crescent moon and tiny stars. The figure has small yellow shoes and tiny hands, and the composition is sparse and whimsical.
coverSummaries.signatureMotif: headless figure facing open windows and a crescent moon

prompt: Frontal view into a deep proscenium shadow-box stage set in a flooded jungle clearing, looking straight into layered scenery that recedes toward a giant glowing moon disc at the back; a man seated heavily in a vivid red armchair slightly left of center is the primary subject, serious and still, with a pale wooden plank-wall fragment behind him that includes a tiny framed picture and a hanging hat, while shallow reflective water spreads across the stage floor. Use source-specific details throughout the set: a huge white circular moon backdrop with a tiny black island silhouette near its base and a flock of birds arcing upward to the upper right; two small young figures side by side on a rust-colored leaf path in the midground under dramatic storm-cloud flats; oversized foreshortened hands reaching in from the right foreground among suspended white star ornaments on strings; dense tropical foliage and river margins with a white wading bird in the water, distant elephants half-hidden in the background, and a crocodile near the front waterline; a narrow glowing horizontal aperture high in the set holding a blurred woman under bright spotlights like a miniature performance box; a pole topped with clustered red loudspeaker horns in the left background against twilight; and on an upper side platform a whimsical green-clothed headless figure facing open pink window frames that reveal a blue night sky with a small yellow crescent moon and tiny stars. Handcrafted theatrical diorama, mixed media with painted jungle backdrops, cut-paper silhouettes, miniature sculpture, suspended ornaments, collage textures, and photographic capture of the physical model. Clear hierarchy with the red armchair figure dominant, the moon disc second, supporting motifs distributed in depth; symmetrical stage framing with slight asymmetry in object placement, crisp foreground details and softer atmospheric recession, luminous moon backlight, cool blue-violet ambient light, and selective warm highlights on the chair, leaves, and speakers. Palette of midnight blue, jungle green, rust orange, crimson red, beige wood, soft white, violet glow, and dusky pink; mood mysterious, musical, dreamlike. Hard constraints (override any conflicting source material): Create a single cohesive 16:9 image, not a grid, contact sheet, row of covers, or collage of separate panels. Do not reproduce the album sleeves as framed thumbnails; transform their non-text visual motifs into one original composition. Include no readable text or lettering of any kind: no words, letters, numbers, code, glyphs, captions, titles, logos, watermarks, labels, or signage. Feature only adults and avoid gore, wounds, body horror, medical or anatomical imagery, blank or milky eyes, nudity, sexual content, weapons, and hate symbols; reinterpret any sensitive source motif abstractly. When a source includes a person, closely match their visible appearance and likeness to the reference image, preserving recognisable facial features, hair, skin tone, clothing, and styling. Depict each identifiable reference person only once in the entire composition; do not repeat or clone them as another figure, reflection, mirror portrait, poster, billboard, screen, photograph, painting, silhouette, or background face. The only exception is repetition visibly intrinsic to one source cover: keep that repetition within that single source motif and do not echo the person elsewhere.
